title: How do I start a separate issue in Help
question: How do I start a separate issue in Help?
answer: Use the New question button in Help to start a separate conversation. Describe what you did, what you expected and what happened; keep follow-up details about an existing problem in its original conversation. If this does not match what you see, send a screenshot in Help.
looks_like: Help has a New question button; a fresh conversation is headed How can we help?
